# DramaClaw

> A source-available (ELv2) self-hosted pipeline from novel to finished video (Community Edition / CE). Runs on a single machine, with no PostgreSQL/Redis required.

## Docs

- [Documentation overview](docs/README.md): entry point of the public docs
- [Features](docs/en/concepts/features.md): what DramaClaw can do (full novel-to-video pipeline capabilities)
- [Architecture](docs/en/concepts/architecture.md): how the system works (flow / code structure / ports and adapters)
- [Quickstart](docs/en/getting-started/quickstart.md): bring up CE locally with a single Docker command
- [Self-hosting handbook](docs/en/guides/self-hosting.md): deployment, configuration, upgrades, backups
- [Configuring model providers](docs/en/getting-started/configuring-models.md): connect your own OpenAI-compatible gateway
- [License notes](docs/en/license.md): what you can do / commercial restrictions (source available)
